o1.biggest_strength: It builds the series around the two retention signals that matter most, with clean platform branching, a gentle inactivity email and clear measurement tied to week-one behavior.
o1.biggest_mistake: Using one of the five onboarding emails for Pro is weaker than using that slot for another habit-forming nudge, even though it is delayed and limited to engaged users.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Replace or A/B the Pro email with a no-recurring/no-second-device rescue email, and make the exact skip/filter logic explicit for the email tool.

o2.biggest_strength: It correctly drops the weak feature, team and Pro emails and keeps the whole series focused on recurring tasks plus a second device.
o2.biggest_mistake: The fifth email largely repeats the recurring-task email and shifts a key success metric to day 14, when the strongest data signal is first-week behavior.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Make the fifth email a sharper branch for the missing habit by day 5 or 6, remove the questionable Pro math, and keep the main measure at day 7.

reason: Both are strong and usable, but Output 1 is more finished, more explicit about goals and week-one measurement, and easier to hand to the team tomorrow. Output 2 has the better instinct to remove Pro entirely, but it is a little more repetitive and less precise on the day-7 success metric.
